_meta.description: Per-row scores on the one common factor behind revenue_before, revenue and session_minutes on experiment.pulse via ATTR_FACTOR_SCORE, each from an inline fit with MAT_FACTOR's knobs (so the same loadings, order and sign as MAT_FACTOR on the same rows). f1_regression is the regression (Thurstone) score of the default minres fit; f1_bartlett is the Bartlett score of a maximum-likelihood fit (params.extraction "ml"). session_minutes shares almost nothing with the revenue pair, so both fits are Heywood cases and each slot warns PULSE_MATRIX_HEYWOOD (fit scope): the minres fit puts revenue_before's uniqueness below 0, so its regression scores still run (about +1.06 on control and -1.18 on variant, with a spread above 1 because the loadings are improper) while a Bartlett score over it would be null; the ML fit holds that uniqueness at its 0.005 floor, so its Bartlett score is essentially standardized revenue_before (about 0 on both arms). On a longer battery set params.factors and a rotation (two factors need at least five members). The fit is cohort-wide, never per treatment; grouping runs the request buffered.
_meta.name: attr_factor_score
